title: Louie's CMsmp
description: This mod adds new blocks, 3D items and mobs to the game *specifically tailored to the CreateMafia server*
body:
This mod aims to give communities more personality and flair by making custom 3Dweapons for the members. The players can obtain those weapons by getting the new crystal drop by killing the Warden and obtaining a new ore from the end.

This mod is still heavenly in development and more tools/weapons/blocks and many more things will be added

To be added next:


Give items better effects
add more weapons
integrate energy and storage
custom crafting
maybe a boss fight???

Currently there are 5 weapons and 3 mobs
